summary: Independent build-7 gate audit reproduced the frozen ZIP and source hashes, verified the build-7 no_action and response-loss repairs against the archived binary, confirmed the absence of a system-notification sink, and accepted RC8 deletion and TTL runtime traces only where the build-7 source-delta proves the underlying retention paths are byte-identical.

artifact_identity_checks.reason: The frozen ZIP and source archive SHA-256 values matched the manifest and verification ledger, and the extracted app reports version 0.1.0 build 7 with the recorded binary hash.

Spot checks of the build-7 source archive matched the current repository copies for the changed no_action, unknown-resolution, and retention files, while the source delta scopes which older runtime traces remain admissible.

requirement_findings.reason: The live build-7 service still denies submission until exact scope confirmation and returns a canonical task only from a reviewed Capsule.
Ambiguous identity remains reviewable without a default binding, and the build-7 delta does not alter that path.
The build-7 first response leads with exact reviewed evidence and the current dependency, and the governed no_action readback remains bound to canonical scope.
Build 7 returns either a governed proposal, clarification, or intentional no_action without silent mutation and without exposing prohibited candidate scoring surfaces.
Stale and expired source handling still routes to refresh or outcome review rather than presenting old authority as current, and build 7 did not alter that boundary.
Fact confirmation remains distinct from action approval; the build-7 delta changes no decision-control semantics.
The Mac path still limits MVP effects to local draft or internal review semantics and does not claim a sent message.
Action Center projections continue to resolve the current canonical object before any decision or reconciliation path is offered.
Build-7 canonical tasks and receipts still read back on shared governed objects without creating a Mac-owned truth record.
The Capsule continues to expose explicit intake and visible boundary copy before submission, and build 7 does not remove those controls.
Ambiguous identity still has no preselected person and preserves a readable unresolved outcome.
Proposal, no_action, and recovery states remain distinguishable by text and structure rather than color alone.
The keyboard-only primary journey remains admissible from the unchanged build-7 control path.
VoiceOver ordering for the consequential journey remains covered by prior recordings, and build 7 adds a direct AX trace for the changed no_action surface.
Reduced Motion behavior remains admissible because build 7 does not introduce new animation-dependent consequence paths.
The zoomed decision and receipt path remains carried forward from unchanged controls in the build-7 delta.
Relaunch now restores a truthful outcome_unknown or canonical receipt without duplicate persistence.
Pause, stop, and clear receipts remain one-step and truthful, and the deletion accounting path is unchanged in build 7.
The build-7 menu-bar and notification proof excludes candidate and evidence content and confirms no system notification sink is linked.
Failed, revoked, and outcome-unknown states do not present as complete and each exposes one safe recovery path.
Build-7 tasks and receipts continue to use the shared canonical contracts with cross-surface readback.
The renderer-to-native boundary remains typed and allowlisted; no arbitrary notification or automation bridge is present in the archived source or binary.
Account-scoped recovery and relaunch isolation remain unchanged in build 7 and retain no prior workspace payload after clear or expiry.
Opening the shell still creates no captured item, and explicit intake remains separately receipted.
The build-7 live tests still prove immutable Capsule version separation and prevent later evidence from altering an earlier Run.
Manual deletion and TTL expiry remain admissible for build 7 because the exact retention implementation and readback script paths are byte-identical across the build-6 to build-7 delta.
Revoked, deleted, and stale evidence is denied on later retrieval and cannot keep prior proposal authority alive.
Build 7 persists one encrypted operation correlation before dispatch and reconciles the original operation ID after relaunch without a second decision POST.
Revocation between preview and decision still fails closed before any canonical review write and produces no success receipt.
The archived build remains within the MVP boundary: loopback-only service, typed bridge, and no Accessibility, Automation, Input Monitoring, Full Disk Access, or notification entitlements.

veto_findings.reason: Build 7 keeps evidence, dependency, owned action, proposal, and no-external-effect boundaries distinct; the repaired no_action path no longer hides a conflicting canonical owned action, and no prohibited candidate-scoring surface was introduced.

The build-7 binary links no system-notification sink, the durable outcome-unknown store encrypts only scoped identifiers and decision metadata rather than candidate message text or bearer credentials, and the retained deletion and TTL traces remain admissible through byte-identical build-7 retention code.

Ambiguous identity still blocks default binding, while build-7 live proof shows the resulting canonical task remains bound to one exact workspace and pursuit scope with no external effects after reviewed candidate attribution and explicit scope confirmation.

Approval, execution, observation, retry, and receipt remain distinct: response loss reconciles the first stable operation without a second POST, and revoked evidence fails before any review write reaches the backend.

The prior keyboard, VoiceOver, reduced-motion, and zoom release journeys remain admissible because build 7 does not alter those control paths, and the changed no_action consequence surface adds direct build-7 screenshot and AX proof with explicit no-duplicate and no-external-effect copy.

limitations: This audit proves the frozen local verification artifact, not notarization or App Store distribution.
Deletion and TTL runtime proof is inherited only for the exact byte-identical build-7 retention paths named in ev-rc9-source-diff; it is not reused for changed no_action or response-loss surfaces.

The current artifact manifest still points ev-review-gate and the frozen veto rows at the older RC6 reviewer identity; this packet is valid on its own but manifest integration must be updated separately before the repository validator can pass.
